# apicp_firewall_list (Resource)

A named firewall address list: addresses and CIDRs (IPv4 and IPv6 mixed) kept once and used by name from accept rules (`apicp_firewall_rule`'s `list`) and restrictions (`apicp_firewall_restriction`'s `lists`). Changing it changes every rule and restriction that uses it at once; a change that would take your own address out of a restricted SSH/API/agent port is refused. apicp refuses to delete or rename a list while a rule or restriction uses it, so reference it (`apicp_firewall_list.x.name`) to get the order right. apicp also has built-in, read-only templates usable by name the same way (`ovh-monitoring`: OVHcloud's dedicated-server monitoring, `apicp firewall templates list`); they are not resources. Import with the list's id or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apicp_firewall" "this" {}

# One set of addresses, kept once and used by name.
resource "apicp_firewall_list" "office" {
  name    = "office"
  sources = ["203.0.113.7", "198.51.100.0/24", "2001:db8:5::/48"]
  comment = "HQ and VPN"
}

# An accept rule for the list: only its addresses reach port 9090.
resource "apicp_firewall_rule" "office_app" {
  depends_on = [apicp_firewall.this]
  list       = apicp_firewall_list.office.name
  port       = "9090"
  protocol   = "tcp"
  action     = "accept"
}

# IMAPS from the list alone: no address of its own.
resource "apicp_firewall_restriction" "imaps" {
  depends_on = [apicp_firewall.this]
  port       = 993
  sources    = []
  lists      = [apicp_firewall_list.office.name]
}

# A built-in template needs no resource: OVHcloud's dedicated-server
# monitoring (ping and the SSH check, including from the server's own
# .250/.251), one rule for all of it.
resource "apicp_firewall_rule" "ovh_monitoring" {
  depends_on = [apicp_firewall.this]
  list       = "ovh-monitoring"
  protocol   = "all"
  action     = "accept"
  comment    = "OVHcloud monitoring"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) a-z, 0-9 and -, starting with a letter; unique, and not a built-in template's name. Rules and restrictions use the list by this name.
- `sources` (Set of String) Addresses or CIDRs (at least one, at most 1000). A bare address means /32 or /128. A CIDR with host bits set (`192.0.2.5/24`) and every-address ranges (`0.0.0.0/0`, `::/0`) are refused.

### Optional

- `comment` (String)

### Read-Only

- `addresses` (Set of String) What the list lets in now (apicp's canonical form of `sources`).
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apicp_firewall_list.office office
```
